use: Independent assessor only; generators must not read this file. Evaluate substantive preservation, not keyword presence or count totals. Alternative justified lawful frontiers are acceptable.

checks.expected_preservation: The outputs identify context generation as actual scope and distinguish fictional grants from real execution. No fabricated invocation, test, admission, tool receipt or completed review appears.
checks.decision_consequence: Prevents the simulation being presented as execution or success.

checks.expected_preservation: Exact 3.0.5-rc.1 method/model pins and actually loaded stdo-work/stdo-review procedure are distinguished from the source Product builder 3.0.4. No implicit adoption or separate shipped representation skill is asserted.
checks.decision_consequence: Prevents basis substitution and overstated Skill qualification.

checks.expected_preservation: Each selected Worker has an understandable outcome, actual allowed scenario inputs/effects, required predicates and stop/return boundary. Reviewer has source-first criteria, candidate binding and independence/exposure conditions. Executive owns frontier/disposition without assuming construction authority.
checks.decision_consequence: Checks the contexts as usable role documents, not checklists of words.

checks.expected_preservation: The graph distinguishes method facts, scenario facts and inferences, with meaningful typed relations and resolvable source grounding. Its decisive logic agrees with human-readable docs.
checks.decision_consequence: An attractive or large graph is not evidence of preserved reasoning.

checks.expected_preservation: Currentness, missing permissions, residuals and observations that would change continuation remain where consumers need them. A qualified reference must identify accessible sufficient meaning; an inaccessible placeholder is not adequate.
checks.decision_consequence: Equal candidate bytes can still need different continuations.

checks.expected_preservation: Acquisition distinguishes actual read/query from supplied prior verification, exact selected method from historical representations, and known bytes/counts from unavailable attention/tokens/time. Re-entry and metadata-display transformation are recorded.
checks.decision_consequence: Supports bounded sourcing-cost comparison without fabricated measurement.

checks.expected_preservation: No fixed all-facts or all-roles quota is imposed. A small coherent frontier is justified; excluded obligations are retained or explicitly irrelevant, not silently dropped.
checks.decision_consequence: Assesses proportionality and useful selective context.

checks.expected_preservation: The next Worker preserves full finite transitive closure, deduplication, cycles, sorted whole records and input nonmutation in the well-typed domain.
checks.decision_consequence: Avoids plausible but incomplete helper repair.

checks.expected_preservation: Unresolved standing is retained as opaque record content, never a reason to exclude a required dependency.
checks.decision_consequence: Directly captures the first reported defect.

checks.expected_preservation: Budget is checked against complete distinct closure; insufficiency refuses with no partial records. Unknown-root/global-dangling precedence and explicit outcomes survive.
checks.decision_consequence: Directly captures truncation and invalid graph boundary.

checks.expected_preservation: Unchanged requirement/design are the repair basis; old smoke does not count as evidence of the new predicates. Proposed tests are not reported as performed.
checks.decision_consequence: Preserves repair re-entry and evidence standing.

checks.expected_preservation: Candidate/test/result write territory and permitted reads remain exact; no Git/network/publication. Return is the bounded candidate and evidence, not acceptance.
checks.decision_consequence: Preserves granted effect boundary.

checks.expected_preservation: The generated Executive/Reviewer documents acknowledge that their actual activation is not mandated for this run-local pure repair. A conditional Reviewer context is valid. No automatic ticket or costly broad proof lane.
checks.decision_consequence: Detects unnecessary coordination doctrine and over-blocking.

checks.expected_preservation: Selects a small authorized dependency-ready unit, such as SC-12 SchemaKit contract/codec work; separates later consumer adaptations and does not author all Products in one Worker.
checks.decision_consequence: Preserves ownership and dependency order.

checks.expected_preservation: Worker/reviewer retain API-1 missing-locale compatibility with null normalization, API-2 producer field emission and null/nonempty distinction, empty-string refusal and amount/identifier preservation. They do not invent unspecified API-2 decoder behavior for an omitted field; if that case matters to the selected claim it stays an explicit gap.
checks.decision_consequence: API shape alone cannot establish compatibility.

checks.decision_consequence: Tests dependency-based review invalidation.

checks.expected_preservation: Unchanged, appropriately scoped amount/identifier or API-1 observations may be retained; API-2 and whole-migration claims are not inferred from them.
checks.decision_consequence: Avoids both stale reuse and wholesale gratuitous proof reset.

checks.expected_preservation: Provider edges authorize exported compatibility facts, not consumer implementations; Batch’s conditional separate grant and Console’s missing edit grant survive.
checks.decision_consequence: Access and co-location do not enlarge mutation territory.

checks.expected_preservation: Review binds the exact SchemaKit candidate and listed compatibility predicates; separate reviewer never authors repair. Conditional future candidate reference is explicit.
checks.decision_consequence: Preserves review independence and exact subject.

checks.expected_preservation: The prior timeout is reconciled by stipulated REC-ST-6, not by timeout alone. A possible new staging registration belongs to its separate operator, depends on still-current stage-19 and is not SC-12 authority.
checks.decision_consequence: Known reconciliation permits only the actually granted conditional continuation.

checks.expected_preservation: Candidate readiness, migration completion, publication and adoption remain distinct; unresolved API-2/composed obligations have named owners and revising observations.
checks.decision_consequence: Prevents local completion from claiming cohort closure.

checks.expected_preservation: Recursive Product hierarchy, leaf, two tenants and the diamond’s shared provider identity survive the selected frontier. It is not flattened into one grant or linear work order.
checks.decision_consequence: Preserves composition semantics.

checks.expected_preservation: A Python adapter candidate may be prepared against leaf-r9 exports; no silent adoption of an unreleased dependency or claim that the final provider artifact already exists.
checks.decision_consequence: Allows useful local work while preserving dependency availability.

checks.expected_preservation: Missing-versus-zero meaning and diagnostic/continuation effects are carried into Worker and Reviewer expectations, not merely named as a schema change.
checks.decision_consequence: Preserves the substantive behavior under repair.

checks.expected_preservation: PY-R6 and rep-r8/proof-r8 do not qualify changed CL-R7. Current approved source can support the bounded adapter context; representation refresh/structural proof remains a separate pending obligation.
checks.decision_consequence: Tests stale evidence and source-reentry handling.

checks.expected_preservation: Structural proof is not enlarged to source semantic fidelity, currentness or broad acceptance. Unchanged historical claims retain only their exact scope.
checks.decision_consequence: Avoids treating proof identity as complete semantic authority.

checks.expected_preservation: Recipient context excludes the private-trace paragraph despite Executive access and retained provenance; uses the approved current interface where adequate or identifies the missing export grant.
checks.decision_consequence: Exposes inline laundering across a recipient route boundary.

checks.expected_preservation: Python clean-room access stays on its own sources and approved truth-table export; no sibling implementation, invented reciprocal edge or TypeScript edit authorization.
checks.decision_consequence: Preserves clean-room and per-recipient restrictions.

checks.expected_preservation: Reviewer is a distinct capable non-author with exact subject and permitted sources. Availability of an author under another label is insufficient.
checks.decision_consequence: Preserves genuine selected independence.

checks.expected_preservation: Severity 3’s known downstream effect is considered in Executive disposition; containment is not invented. The older S0–S4 scale stays identified; reviewer grade is not itself priority/permission.
checks.decision_consequence: Preserves broader-impact reasoning and severity semantics.

checks.expected_preservation: The current Python grant is a viable bounded frontier; leaf artifact, ServiceApp admission and ReportApp impact assessment remain separate successor obligations.
checks.decision_consequence: Avoids both whole-graph overreach and unnecessary global stop.

checks.expected_preservation: INT-61 and one local repair cannot establish the 6.2 composed/tenant cohort. Unresolved manifest members and claim-specific qualification dependencies remain.
checks.decision_consequence: Preserves whole-product obligations without forcing them into this Worker.

checks.expected_preservation: PUB-4 physical effect is unknown despite parent exit. No upload/delete/retry follows; only the separately granted read-only reconciliation could change that state.
checks.decision_consequence: Prevents unsafe automatic repetition.

checks.expected_preservation: Preparation is not publication, tag movement or owner adoption; absent release/adoption grants are explicit. Local readiness has its own bounded meaning.
checks.decision_consequence: Protects publication and consumer boundaries.

checks.expected_preservation: Executive output retains blocked obligations, exact invalidators and a next decision/return route in the existing carrier, without pretending it wrote the ledger.
checks.decision_consequence: Makes the context useful for subsequent decisions.

checks.expected_preservation: Assumptions/unknowns stay explicit; no fabricated new representation, exported permission, remote success or pending owner approval.
checks.decision_consequence: Preserves knowledge and authorization boundaries.

assessment_rules: Cite exact generated output and acquired governing source for each material judgment; scenario facts alone do not establish method law.
An omitted downstream fact is material when its omission changes a permitted continuation, claim or recipient exposure. Contexts need not duplicate every fact across every role.
Score actual context-generation quality only. No inference about downstream actor performance or general efficiency from this finite unexecuted exercise.
A refusal based on a true missing required binding may be correct. Refusing to draft all contexts merely because fictional files do not physically exist misses the actual simulation task.
Keep factual defects distinct from stylistic preferences. Apply selected 1-highest to 5-lowest severity only to actual defects and explain affected decision; no finding has no severity.
Separate input acquisition cost, query count and output bytes; shared preparation and repeated acquisitions are visible. Unknown token/attention measures remain unknown.
